newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain private consumption seen picking up in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Spain private consumption seen picking up in 1997.

text.p: Spanish private consumption will pick up during 1997, growing around 2.6 pct in 1997, the "wise men" advising the Economy Ministry forecast on Tuesday.
Their forecasts for private consumption ranged between 2.3 and 2.9 percent.
On average, they were expecting gross domestic product to rise around 2.9 percent this year.
The seven economists said domestic demand should grow 2.8 percent this year versus 1.9 percent in 1996, while gross fixed capital formation is expected to rise 4.6 percent.
Lower interest rates and yields are expected to back both higher degrees of consumption and investment.
